step1.intro: Tell us the basics about your store. Your business type shapes how the AI is tuned.
step1.languageHint: You can change this anytime from the EN/JP toggle in the sidebar.
step1.storeNamePlaceholder: e.g., La Estro 美容整体
step1.aiTuningHeading: AI tuning for this business type
step1.customizeHint: You can add + edit your own items later in Settings → AI. SYNQED-curated base items are read-only.

step2.intro: Choose how transparent you want recording to be. Japanese law doesn't require explicit notification — pick the mode that matches your brand, industry, and clientele.
step2.privacyConfirm: Our privacy policy includes the AI-recording purpose-of-use
step2.modeAWarning: Mode A requires your privacy policy to disclose "AI voice recording" as a purpose-of-use (APPI Art. 17). Pick Mode B or C if your policy isn't updated yet.

step3.intro: Confirm your choices and finish setup. You can change everything later in Settings.
step3.footnote: All settings can be changed anytime in Settings after setup.

privacy.heading: Privacy & data
privacy.intro: APPI-compliant actions for {customerName}'s data. Owner or assigned-staff permission required.
privacy.accessBody: See which staff accessed or modified {customerName}'s data, when, and from where (audit log).
privacy.exportBody: Exports profile, karute, memory, photos, and recording transcripts as an encrypted PDF (signed URL, valid 24 hours).
privacy.deleteBody: Soft-deletes all data and schedules permanent deletion in 30 days (APPI's reasonable period). Scope: karute, memory, photos, recordings. Reversible within 30 days.
privacy.footer: These actions are logged to the audit trail. After 30 days, deletions are irreversible. Owner confirmation recommended.

aiBodyPrediction.title: AI Body Condition Prediction
aiBodyPrediction.description: Estimates the customer's current condition + recommended next-visit window from session history, with rationale. Includes a confidence % so staff know how heavily to weight it.

aiOutreach.title: AI Recommended Message
aiOutreach.description: Drafts a follow-up LINE / SMS / email after each session based on the customer's memory + this visit's notes. Staff can edit before sending, or approve as-is.

aiSummary.title: AI Session Summary
aiSummary.description: Bullet-list summary of what happened in today's session — concerns raised, treatments done, products discussed, next steps. Auto-extracted from the recording + entries.

recordingTranscript.title: Recording & Transcript
recordingTranscript.description: Full audio recording with searchable transcript, speaker diarization (who said what), and consent badge. Played back during the next session for context.

reengagement.title: AI Follow-up Message
reengagement.description: Drafts a personal re-engagement message from this customer's memory + session history. Sits above the tabs so staff catch it on profile open without a tab switch. Edit and send via LINE / SMS / email.

dataImport.title: Data Import
dataImport.description: Import customers and appointments from CSV or Excel files
dataImport.dropOrClick: Drop a file here or click to upload
dataImport.supportedTypes: Supports CSV, Excel (.xlsx), and JSON files
dataImport.csvDescription: UTF-8 or Shift-JIS encoded. Auto-detects column mapping.
dataImport.excelDescription: First sheet is used. Headers in first row.
dataImport.jsonDescription: Array of customer objects with name, phone, email fields.

dataExport.title: Data Export
dataExport.description: Pull customers, bookings, and karute records out of Karute as CSV, Excel, or JSON. APPI-aware — set redaction once, applies across every column.
dataExport.scopeQuestion: What do you want to export?
dataExport.pdfHint: PDF exports use the per-karute print layout. One file per record, packed into a ZIP for batches above 1.
dataExport.noColumnsSelected: No columns selected — file would be empty.
dataExport.narrowDescription: Narrow which records make it into the file.
dataExport.advancedDescription: Privacy + delivery options. Defaults match Karute's APPI compliance baseline.
dataExport.redactPiiDescription: Replace names, contact info, and transcript text with pseudonymous tokens. IDs are preserved so you can re-join with the source. Required for off-store sharing under APPI.
dataExport.scheduleHintWeekly: We'll email a signed link every Monday at 09:00 JST.
dataExport.scheduleHintMonthly: We'll email a signed link on the 1st of the month at 09:00 JST.
dataExport.karuteShareWarning: Karute exports include diarized transcripts and customer memory. Verify the recipient has signed your data processing agreement before sharing externally.
dataExport.auditNote: Exports are logged in the audit trail. Files are encrypted at rest and a signed-URL link expires after 24 hours.
dataExport.comingSoonExport: This combination is coming soon — only customers + CSV is wired today.
dataExport.footerNote: All exports are logged in the audit trail

hero.title: Never write a karute by hand again
hero.subtitle: Record your client sessions. Karute uses AI to transcribe, extract key details, and generate a complete karute — automatically.

howItWorks.heading: How it works
howItWorks.subtitle: Three simple steps to go from session to karute
howItWorks.step1Description: Hit record during your session. Karute captures the conversation in the background while you focus on your client.
howItWorks.step2Description: Karute transcribes the audio, extracts preferences, treatments, and concerns, then generates a structured summary.
howItWorks.step3Description: Review the AI-generated karute, make any edits, and save. It's linked to the customer and appointment automatically.
